audit: 2026-09-09 duplicate sweep: scripts/dupe_gate.py added and run across the whole bank. It scores each question on subtopic_detail plus the correct option, within topic, after folding AU and US spelling variants and common clinical synonyms, and treats a differing dose as a different question so the 150 and 300 microgram adrenaline bands are not collapsed. Sixteen pairs scored at or above 0.90, forming eleven duplicate clusters over 26 questions; the newest of each cluster was kept and the other 15 moved to data/_archived_dupes/. The largest was five separate varenicline smoking cessation questions with the same correct answer. Bank 5509 to 5494. The gate is now a mandatory pre-publish step in the scheduled routine.
